title: Temple of Ptah
summary: A northern temple with a long sequence of royal interventions; deeper research will use the CFEETK epigraphic publication.
orientation: Northern part of the Amun precinct.

claims.text: The temple lies in the northern Amun complex.

caveats: The official archive warns that the statues now positioned in the central and southern rooms are not in their original locations; independently verify the archive text before publishing a reconstructed ancient viewpoint.
The CFEETK monograph, rather than popular dramatic-light stories, is the next source target.
